| Parameter | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Output** `output` | Regions | Regions, Boundaries over the image, Mean color of each region | The superpixels as a label map, drawn over the image and listed in the Features panel. Or the boundaries in yellow over the image, or each superpixel filled with its mean color. |
| **Superpixels** `segments` | 100 | 2 to 5000 | About how many superpixels to make. scikit-image uses 100. The result can have fewer. |
| **Compactness** `compactness` | 10 | 0.01 to 100 | How much position counts against color. scikit-image uses 10. |
| **Iterations** `iterations` | 10 | 1 to 50 | The number of k-means steps. scikit-image uses 10. |
| **Smoothing** `sigma` | 0 | 0 to 5 px | The sigma of a Gaussian blur before clustering. scikit-image uses 0, no blur. |
